"We have learned one lesson, however, from our fight for the ACA— the fight doesn’t stop because a bill has become law. The fight must continue."

Read Senator Harry Reid's op-ed from just a few months ago about the need for a public option ⤵️
https://t.co/gFBPUJAJBK

The American Rescue Plan ensured that four out of five enrollees were able to purchase health insurance for $10 or less per month. This overwhelming success of this ACA open enrollment period is not a coincidence.

Today @EPAMichaelRegan joined me to see first-hand how the climate crisis is impacting Saco's wastewater treatment facility where rising sea levels have caused constant flooding. 

Thankfully the new infrastructure law makes the biggest investment in water infrastructure EVER! https://t.co/bOOaHfDWVn

Maine’s first woman pediatrician, Dr. Alice Whittier, who lived at this house on Neal St., is remembered as a physician who served all the patients who came to her, regardless of their ability to pay https://t.co/lDYKm0LDII
Happy 12th Birthday 🎂 to the lifesaving Affordable Care Act, which guaranteed that Americans with a pre-existing condition could no longer be denied health care coverage! https://t.co/axx6RwiBBg

Three years ago today, the federal government approved Maine’s Medicaid expansion. Thankfully @GovJanetMills signed an executive order to begin its implementation on her first day in office — which voters passed overwhelmingly two years earlier.

Here’s something to 😃 about: today is the official launch of virtual dental homes in Maine!

Too many kids, even those with insurance, are not getting the preventive dental care they need. That’s why as a member of @AppropsDems I fought for $650,000  in federal funds to help 🦷 https://t.co/1dImvt7HUh

How many mass slaughters in our elementary schools, grocery stores, or hospitals will it take for my Republican colleagues to put blind partisanship aside and recognize that it is downright reckless to permit teenagers to buy weapons of war without so much as a background check?

It’s estimated that just about every American has traces of PFAS chemicals in their system.
 
Today, @RepDavidRouzer + I introduced the Healthy H2O Act to make testing and treatment technology more accessible so our communities can be protected against these harmful chemicals https://t.co/iwwYxksfmi

Patients and providers entering reproductive health care centers should have the same level of security and safety Justice Kavanaugh has going to work. 

That's why I am cosponsoring @RepEscobar's #HealthcareProvidersSafetyAct.

2+ million people in 🇺🇸 have an opioid use disorder and half of all Americans will be diagnosed with a mental illness or disorder in their lifetime. That’s why it’s so egregious that the federal gov't has underfunded mental health + substance use disorder treatment for so long.

The bipartisan Restoring Hope for Mental Health and Well-Being Act includes an unprecedented expansion of access to medication-assisted treatment programs, which we know are among the most effective ways to help people on the road to recovery.

GREAT NEWS: The House just passed legislation to extend Covid-era child nutrition waivers. As we’ve seen in Maine, these waivers are a lifeline for students whose households are grappling with rising food costs and for school districts that are navigating supply chain issues.

It'll take ALL of us to end hunger and reduce diet-related diseases and the disparities surrounding them. 

Whether you have experienced hunger directly or not, your input matters. Please take time to fill out this survey so I can share them with @POTUS https://t.co/RRuinVMsXl

#OTD 57 yrs ago the Medicare & Medicaid Act was signed. In 2017 Maine became the 1st state to approve Medicaid (MaineCare) expansion at the ballot box, but it took a governor who listened to the people to make it a reality + extend this life-saving coverage. TY @GovJanetMills! https://t.co/N7x6G0TPxA

This headline says it all. 

The Inflation Reduction Act will lower health care costs for older Americans by finally giving Medicare the power to negotiate Rx drug prices.

I am voting yes! https://t.co/zDRh9INmCd

The Inflation Reduction Act will lower health care 🩺 costs by ➖Empowering Medicare to Negotiate Drug Prices
➖Providing an Inflation Rebate for Seniors on Medicare 
➖Setting a $2,000 Out-Of-Pocket Cap for Seniors on Medicare
➖Extending enhanced ACA subsidies for 3 years https://t.co/9aGYlDUwGO

Since I was a Maine State Senator, I have been fighting to lower Rx prices for our seniors. Today I will join @HouseDemocrats to pass the historic Inflation Reduction Act to FINALLY allow Medicare to negotiate the price of prescription drugs. https://t.co/VzHDxwiIo2

The Inflation Reduction Act will empower Medicare to directly negotiate drug prices, impacting nearly 350,000 beneficiaries in Maine.

That's just another reason why I'm voting yes today!
Your regular reminder that Republicans in Congress voted against capping insulin out-of-pockets costs for Americans with private health insurance.
ICYMI: @HouseDemocrats & @SenateDems passed the Inflation Reduction Act which capped Medicare beneficiaries’ insulin costs at $35 a month.

Today I tested positive for COVID-19. Although I am only experiencing mild symptoms thanks to being vaccinated and boosted, for the safety of others I will be isolating at home while working remotely for my constituents.

I am pawsitively🐾honored to receive @HSLegFund's 2022 #HumaneAdvocateAward! As my “chief”🐶 will tell you, fighting for the humane treatment of animals everywhere is a top priority in my office. https://t.co/1x3YMmDY1H

Maine’s own Jeanne Reilly, director of school nutrition at 14 Windham/Raymond school ✏️ district RSU 14, is here at the @WhiteHouse Conference on Hunger to share and learn about the importance of nutrition🍎and reducing waste 🗑 in our schools! #mepolitics https://t.co/Y4Qn3kTY51
When Republicans tell you they will cut Social Security and Medicare, BELIEVE THEM. https://t.co/8yR3WNxe85
